# Braids by Latifah

> Private braiding suite in the Bon Air area of North Chesterfield (Richmond), Virginia. Latifah is a Congolese braider with 13 years of experience doing all braids, twists and weave. Braiding hair is provided on most styles. Book on Booksy or by text; a deposit is required.

Also known as: Congolese Hair Design by Latifah (Instagram and Facebook name).

## Contact and location
- Address: 101 Buford Rd, Suite 203-9, North Chesterfield, VA 23235 (Bon Air, south side of Richmond)
- Phone / text: (804) 664-8199. Text to book; no Instagram or Facebook DMs, please.
- Booking: https://booksy.com/en-us/1588457_braids-by-latifah_braids-locs_134575_richmond
- Website: https://braids-by-latifah-website.netlify.app/

## Hours
- Monday to Saturday: 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM
- Sunday: closed

## Reputation
- Booksy: 5.0 stars from 35 reviews
- Google: 5.0 stars from 13 reviews

## Booking policies
- Deposit required to secure every appointment (Latifah confirms the amount when you book).
- Braiding hair is provided on most styles. Not included: French curls, springy bohemian twists, Bobby faux locs; boho styles use client-provided curly hair.
- Arrive with hair prepped as discussed when booking.
- Closed Sundays.

## Services and prices (from the Booksy menu; "from" means a starting price)
### Knotless & Box Braids
- Knotless smedium box braids: from $220, about 6h. Hair included
- Box braids: from $200, about 5h 30min
- Tribal braids / box braids: from $150, about 5h
- Micro braids: from $200, about 6h
- Classic bob (burnt): from $180, about 4h 30min

### Boho & Curls
- Bohemian or boho box braids: from $250, about 6h 30min. Curly hair is not included
- French curls: from $200, about 5h. Hair not included
- Springy bohemian twists: from $220, about 4h 30min. Hair is not included
- Boho bob: $200, about 4h 30min. Braiding hair included; client provides the curly hair

### Cornrows & Feed-ins
- Cornrow braids: from $80, about 2h 30min
- Cornrows men: from $60, about 2h
- Feed-ins: from $15, about 30min. $15 per braid, or 2 for $40 with braiding hair included
- Cornrows under the wig: $50, about 30min

### Twists
- 2-strand twist: $80, about 3h 30min
- Senegalese twist: from $200, about 6h
- Marley twist: from $200, about 5h
- Kinky twist: from $180, about 5h
- Spring twist: from $180, about 5h
- Island twist: from $180, about 3h 30min

### Weave & Wigs
- Weave sew-in: from $100, about 3h 30min. Leave-out and full sew-in only. No closure or lace frontal.
- Wig install: from $100, about 2h 30min

### Kids
- Box braids kids: from $150, about 4h. Under 12
- Cornrows kids: from $60, about 2h 30min

### Locs & Crochet
- Butterfly locs: $200, about 5h 30min
- Soft dread: $180, about 2h 30min. Hair included
- Bobby faux locs: $200, about 4h. Hair not included
- Crochet braids: from $100, about 3h
- Loc retwist: $60, about 1h 30min. Regular size; small is extra
- Retwist locs: from $60, about 2h

### Extras
- Wash: $20, about 20min
- Touch-up service: from $80, about 2h 30min
- Take out (all types of braids): from $20, about 1h 30min. Depending on the style and size of the braids

Price range: $15 (feed-in, per braid) to $250+ (boho box braids).

## Frequently asked questions
**Is braiding hair included?**
Yes, on most styles. Latifah provides the braiding hair, and the menu flags the exceptions: French curls, springy bohemian twists and Bobby faux locs do not include hair, and boho styles need client-provided curly hair.

**Do I need a deposit to book?**
Yes. A deposit is required to secure every appointment. Latifah confirms the amount when you book.

**How do I book an appointment?**
Book online through Booksy, or text (804) 664-8199. Please text instead of sending Instagram or Facebook DMs.

**How much do braids cost?**
Knotless smedium box braids start at $220 with hair included, box braids start at $200, and boho box braids start at $250. Cornrows start at $80 and feed-ins are $15 per braid.

**What are your hours?**
Monday to Saturday, 8 AM to 7 PM. The suite is closed on Sundays.

**Where are you located?**
In a private suite at 101 Buford Rd, Suite 203-9, North Chesterfield, VA 23235, in the Bon Air area on the south side of Richmond.

**How long does a braid appointment take?**
Most full braid styles take 4 to 6.5 hours. Knotless smedium is about 6 hours, box braids about 5.5 hours, and a 2-strand twist about 3.5 hours.

**Can you braid short or fine hair?**
Yes. Latifah braids short and fine hair, and offers lighter styles for anyone who does not like heavy braids. Text a photo of your hair if you are unsure.

**Do you braid kids and men?**
Yes. Kids box braids (under 12) start at $150 and kids cornrows start at $60. Men’s cornrows start at $60.

**Do you do locs and crochet?**
Yes: loc retwists from $60, butterfly locs, soft dreads, Bobby faux locs and crochet braids from $100.
